basic_profile.bio: I'm a 35-year-old strategy game enthusiast based in Seattle. By day, I work as a software developer, and by night, I'm diving deep into strategy games like Civilization and exploring new guitar mods. I've been a Redditor for over seven years, and I love engaging in discussions about game mechanics and music. I usually browse Reddit during my morning coffee and late at night, often staying up too late. I'm currently single and enjoy the freedom to explore my hobbies extensively.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in Computer Science and have been coding professionally for over a decade. My passion for strategy games started when I was a teenager, and I've been playing various iterations of Civilization ever since. My knowledge about guitar mods is self-taught through online tutorials and community forums.
